# Order-55 reference and novelty record

Retrieval/check date: 2026-09-09. External source stays under references/.

- ALETHEIA-54: https://github.com/ruu413/aletheia-54 ; local
  `references/aletheia-54`; local HEAD and `git ls-remote origin HEAD` both
  `c1332afa5d406373ec47f63dc3f187aee4a6cecf`. Code MIT; documents and proof
  records CC BY 4.0. Relevant files actually read: bounds.py, search.cpp,
  global_maximum_certificate.py, profile_lift.cpp, known_records.json,
  README.md, LICENSE. Its generic searcher was compiled without modifying
  upstream source. The even-order proof machinery was not used as a black box.
- Brent–Yedidia: https://arxiv.org/abs/1801.00399v6 (2021-02-20), and
  https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/journals/JIS/VOL21/Brent/brent11.html . Updated
  arXiv abstract says exact tables through 53. Publisher landing-page
  abstract is older and says 52; the version distinction was checked.
  Copyright remains with original rights holders; no redistribution license
  is inferred from public access.
- OEIS: https://oeis.org/A086432 and its b086432.txt; b-file ends at 53.
  OEIS licensing: https://oeis.org/wiki/The_OEIS_End-User_License_Agreement .
- Brent maximal determinant pages:
  https://maths-people.anu.edu.au/~brent/maxdet/ .
- S. Braić, Glasnik Matematicki 45(65) (2010), 291–305:
  https://web.math.pmf.unizg.hr/glasnik/45.2/45(2)-01.pdf . Theorem 4.4 and
  p.297 explicitly support the (55,27,13) difference-set obstruction;
  theorem references Lander (1983), pp.131,134. The final note also gives a
  self-contained proof using Phi5 modulo 2. Public access is not treated as
  a new license to redistribute the PDF.
- Kathleen Nowak: https://arxiv.org/abs/1409.0114v1 (2014-08-30), definition
  and context of almost difference sets. Standard arXiv access; no open
  derivative license is inferred.

Final web queries included the full integer
`134694094094758395331307111329132`, `D_01(55)`, `binary circulant determinant
55`, `maximum determinant order 55 circulant`, `55x55 binary circulant`,
and targeted arXiv, GitHub, Zenodo, and Brent-domain searches. No matching
prior exact determination was returned in the inspected sources. The
search is not an exhaustive bibliography and does not exclude unpublished
work. Direct Google Scholar coverage was not independently established.

We found no prior published exact determination in the sources checked as
of 2026-09-09. No absolute-priority claim is made.
